1) 先排除刚重启导致的缓存冷启动；2) 查 V$BUFFERPOOL 确认各缓: 1) First rule out a cold cache after a restart; 2) Query V$BUFFERPOOL for each buffer pool's hit ratio and size; 3) Raise the BUFFER parameter in dm.ini (typically a set fraction of physical memory) and restart to apply; 4) Also look for full-table-scan SQL flushing the cache and add indexes to eliminate it.
1) 查 V$LOCK 与 V$SESSIONS 关联，找出持锁最久的会话及其执: 1) Join V$LOCK with V$SESSIONS to find the session holding locks longest and the SQL it is running; 2) Determine whether it is a long uncommitted transaction or hot-row update contention; 3) As an emergency measure run SP_CLOSE_SESSION on the blocking session to release the locks; 4) For the root cause, shorten transactions and enforce a consistent locking order; consider serialising hot-row updates through a queue.
1) 用达梦客户端手工执行一条简单查询确认响应速度；2) 查 V$SESSION: 1) Run a simple query by hand with the Dameng client to gauge the response time; 2) Query V$SESSIONS and V$LOCK for a pile-up of sessions or lock waits; 3) Check the collector account's connection quota and the network latency to the database; 4) If the database really is busy, follow the slow-query path; on the collector side you can lengthen the interval so it does not add load.
1) 登录主机确认 dmserver 进程是否存活；2) 进程存活则用 disq: 1) Log in to the host and confirm the dmserver process is alive; 2) If it is alive, connect by hand with disql to tell a hung instance from a network or account problem; 3) If it is not running, read the tail of dm_<instance>.log to identify the cause (full disk, insufficient memory, corrupted data files) before starting it; 4) If a standby exists, immediately assess whether to fail over.
Dameng 指标采集耗时过长: Dameng metric collection taking too long
Dameng 缓存命中率过低: Dameng cache hit ratio too low
存在轻量级锁竞争，会导致SQL执行延迟: Lightweight lock contention detected, which delays SQL execution
缓存命中率低于95%会导致大量磁盘IO，性能下降: Cache hit ratio below 95% causes heavy disk IO and degrades performance
达梦数据缓冲区命中率低于 95%，大量数据块要从磁盘读取，查询延迟和磁盘 IO: The Dameng data buffer hit ratio is below 95%: many data blocks are read from disk and both query latency and disk IO rise noticeably.
达梦锁等待线程数超过 10，说明有事务长时间持锁，其他事务被阻塞排队，业务会出现: More than 10 threads are waiting on Dameng locks, which means a transaction is holding locks for a long time and blocking others; the workload will see widespread timeouts.
采集端已连不上达梦数据库，实例可能已崩溃或网络不通，依赖该库的业务全部不可用。: The collector can no longer reach the Dameng database; the instance may have crashed or the network may be down, and every workload depending on it is unavailable.
采集耗时过长反映数据库响应慢，可能导致监控数据延迟: Long collection time indicates a slow database response and may delay monitoring data
采集达梦指标的耗时超过 5 秒，通常说明数据库本身已经很慢或连接受阻，采集数据也: Collecting Dameng metrics takes more than 5 seconds, which usually means the database itself is slow or connections are blocked — the collected data will start to be misleading too.
